info.title: FareFair API
info.description: REST API over the FareFair PostgreSQL schema: city datasets, versioned fare matrices, ordinances, the statutory fare engine, ML model registry/training and trip analytics. Blank optional query parameters are treated as absent. Empty result sets return 200 with an empty data array. Only invalid values (for example an unknown enum value, a malformed UUID or malformed JSON) return 400.

post.summary: Sign in with a seeded admin account
post.description: Verifies the password against the scrypt hash in admin_users and issues an opaque bearer token stored as a SHA-256 digest in admin_sessions. Five consecutive failures lock the login for 15 minutes. Unknown accounts fail with the same 401 and take the same time as a wrong password.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque session token returned by POST /v1/auth/login. The server stores only its SHA-256 digest and expires it after 8 hours. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
